waiting_period_initial.value: There is an initial 30-day waiting period from the policy start date for all medical and surgical treatments, except for accidental bodily injuries.
waiting_period_initial.clause: A waiting period of thirty (30) days from the inception date of this Policy shall apply to all medical and surgical treatments, except in case of accidental bodily injury occurring during the policy period.

waiting_period_preexisting.value: Pre-existing diseases and their direct complications require 36 months of continuous coverage before being covered.
waiting_period_preexisting.clause: Pre-Existing Diseases and their direct complications shall not be covered until 36 continuous months of health insurance coverage have elapsed since the inception of the first policy with us.

waiting_period_specific.value: A 24-month continuous coverage waiting period applies to specific illnesses and procedures including cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement surgery, and calculus diseases.
waiting_period_specific.clause: The expenses on treatment of the following specified illnesses and procedures: cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement surgery, and calculus diseases shall be payable only after a waiting period of 24 months of continuous coverage under this policy.

room_rent_cap.value: Daily room rent, boarding, and nursing expenses are capped at 1% of the Sum Insured up to a Single Private AC Room per day. Proportionate deductions apply if a higher category room is chosen.
room_rent_cap.clause: Daily Room Rent, boarding and nursing expenses up to 1% of Sum Insured subject to a maximum of Single Private AC Room per day. If higher category room is occupied, proportionate deductions will apply to associated medical expenses.

copay.value: 10% co-payment for insured individuals aged 60 years or older on all admissible claims, and zero co-payment for members under 60 years at network hospitals.
copay.clause: A co-payment of 10% shall apply to each and every admissible claim if the insured person is aged 60 years or above at the time of claim intimation. For members below 60 years of age, zero co-payment shall apply for network hospitals.

sub_limits.value: Cataract surgery is capped at Rs. 40,000 per eye, and Robotic/Cyberknife surgeries are capped at 50% of the total Sum Insured.
sub_limits.clause: Expenses related to Cataract surgery shall be capped at Rs. 40,000 per eye. Robotic / Cyberknife surgeries are covered up to a sub-limit of 50% of the total Sum Insured.

exclusions.value: Treatments for alcoholism, drug abuse, self-inflicted injury, aesthetic/cosmetic procedures, weight loss surgeries, and hazardous sports (without explicit endorsement) are permanently excluded.
exclusions.clause: The following conditions are permanently excluded: treatment for alcoholism, drug abuse, self-inflicted injury, aesthetic or cosmetic treatments, weight reduction surgeries, and hazardous sports unless explicitly endorsed in writing.

claim_conditions.value: For planned hospitalization, notify the insurer at least 48 hours before admission. For emergency hospitalization, inform within 24 hours. Submit all claim documents within 30 days after discharge.
claim_conditions.clause: In case of planned hospitalization, the Company must be intimating at least 48 hours prior to admission. In case of emergency hospitalization, intimation must be given within 24 hours of admission. Complete claim documents must be submitted within 30 days of discharge.
